# Before data collection

## Analysis plan

Before starting to collect or analyse data, you want to have a plan of your analysis. Please use this format Plan for the [analysis.docx](https://universitelibrebruxelles-my.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/personal/irene_cogliati_dezza_ulb_be/Documents/Material%20for%20students/Plan%20for%20the%20analysis.docx?d=w3bb7bad926644219866c8dc43c069536&csf=1&web=1&e=4nzCrb). Make sure to download it first, fill it in and then add it to the shared folder with your name.

## Programming

### R

Here how to install R studio <https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/starting.html>

Here some tutorials to use R <https://www.r-bloggers.com/>

<https://bloggers.feedspot.com/r_programming_blogs/>

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_V8eKsto3Ug&ab_channel=freeCodeCamp.org>

Each time you write a script make sure to explain in detail what aspect of the code is needed for. If relevant, create a ReadMe.doc in which you explain what the code does and add the ReadMe.doc to the shared folder.

You may contact Catherine Culot et de Nathan Vaccaro for extra help! You may use chatgpt for extra help just make sure to **check the output!!!**

If you are using tidy R, please use the following style guide: <https://style.tidyverse.org/>

Those cheat sheets are also very useful: <https://www.rstudio.com/resources/cheatsheets/>

### Python

Writing scripts in Python. You can use this tutorial for more information on how to write codes in python [Python_LectureSlides.pdf](https://universitelibrebruxelles-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/irene_cogliati_dezza_ulb_be/EQtnjrUyzQJKq_KsEl5knv4BNhzbX-YQfHMllujwDCiaFw?e=1Zxr7b)

### Troubleshooting

Altough you can use LLM (like ChatGPT) to help you with troubleshooting, you should always check the output and make sure it is correct. Apart from that, [Stackoverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions) is a great resource to find solutions to your problems. You can also go to this [book](https://bookdown.org/guokai8/mastering-r-through-errors/docs/) [@guo].

## Ethics

If your project needs ethical approval, submit it through monpsy -\> Recherche & Doctorat -\> Ethique

Discuss this with your supervisor first!
